name: Kimi ni Madoi, Kimi ni Oboreru.
source:
An omegaverse visual novel.

The story’s protagonist is the 23-year-old Sayo Tsuyuki, who has lived her life so far without a “secondary gender,” but is suddenly told that she has been an omega all along. However, in this world, “all omegas who don’t find a mate before the age of 25 die,” and the only way to escape that fate is to mate with an alpha. So, in order to [i]literally[/i] survive, Sayo decides to dedicate the remaining two years of her life to finding a mate. At the same time, she returns to her hometown after five long years, reuniting with some of her old childhood friends, who help her discover true love, but also ignite an “uncontrollable instinct” within her.

[From [url=https://automaton-media.com/en/news/mate-or-die-major-womens-game-developer-in-japan-explains-how-the-straight-omegaverse-works-in-its-upcoming-switch-exclusive-visual-novel/]Automaton[/url]]
translation:
一部欧米伽宇宙视觉小说。

故事的主角是23岁的露木纱代，她一直过着没有“第二性别”的生活，却突然被告知她一直都是omega。然而，在这个世界上，“所有在25岁之前找不到伴侣的omega都会死去”，而摆脱这种命运的唯一方法就是与alpha交配。因此，为了[i]真正[/i]生存，Sayo决定将生命中剩下的两年奉献给寻找伴侣。与此同时，她时隔五年回到家乡，与一些儿时的老朋友重逢，他们帮助她找到了真爱，但也点燃了她内心“无法控制的本能”。
